messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: metering.alerts.usage_delay - delayed usage ingestion for apac region causing temporary overage flags for some customers. Window: 2026-03-21T18:00Z - present.
zara-oncall: taking ownership. Paging @matt-billing and @noah-sre.
matt-billing: seeing 12 overage_flags in APAC, mostly small accounts. Shadow counters are higher than live.
noah-sre: checking ingestion. apac-kafka consumer lags: partition 0 lag=0, partition 1 lag=0, partition 2 lag=0. Hmm. Could be downstream aggregator backlog.
ops-bot: query: aggregator queue depth apac-aggregator: backlog=4500 messages, processing rate=120/s
noah-sre: aggregator stuck on node apac-agg-2 with repeated SQL timeout errors to billing-db. Looks like DB connection pool exhaustion.
azara-oncall: can we scale aggregator replicas?
ops-bot: scaling deployment apac-aggregator replicas 2 -> 6.
claire-cs: pausing billing emails for APAC and sending CS note.
matt-billing: are any bills applied already? I see 3 invoices queued but not charged. Holding them.
noah-sre: increasing DB pool size temporarily and applying index hint for aggregator query. Rolling restart aggregator pods.
ops-bot: rollout: apac-aggregator updated, pods restarting.
noah-sre: backlog draining; rate now 420/s. ETA ~ 10m to clear backlog.
ops-bot: billing_hold toggled true for region=apac.
claire-cs: CS outreach in progress for the 12 affected accounts; template uses "no charges applied" language.
matt-billing: reconciler scheduled: `billing-reconcile --range "2026-03-21T17:30Z/2026-03-21T18:30Z" --region apac --auto-clear` job=rec-apac-1770056789.
noah-sre: monitors show steady state, backlog down to 0, aggregator errors gone.
ops-bot: reconciler rec-apac-1770056789 status=success -> 12 flags cleared.
claire-cs: confirmed with 6 customers, no charge applied. All good.
zara-oncall: root cause = aggregator DB connection pool exhaustion causing processing backlog -> live usage delay -> overage flags. Mitiations: scaled aggregator, increased DB pool, applied index hint, added queue-depth alert and autoscale.
matt-billing: follow-ups: BILL-1289 (queue alert + autoscale), SRE-2156 (DB pool tuning), CS-452 (customer comms playbook).
zara-oncall: closing in 20m if stable. Thanks.
incident-bot: Pager resolved: metering.alerts.usage_delay severity=P3 duration=42m
